realProofCoverage: Two genuinely signed BABE/VRF reports with archived SDK-generated membership proofs pass real outer Utility batch admission, cryptographic verification, offence recording, financial queueing and disabling. Election results are supplied by the test fixture. The four-call BABE/GRANDPA admission matrix separately uses structural proofs to isolate weight admission.

constraints: Runs the candidate Core_initialize_block against pinned archive state after a local :code overlay; no governance dispatch, consensus verification, block finalization or network submission is exercised.
Stops immediately after initialization and checks its storage diff; does not advance unrelated bridge multi-block migrations.
The prior cache contains only block-hash-scoped immutable upstream reads and is never modified. New remote reads are cached only in this process.
Mock signatures and unresolved imports are executor settings only. Offchain workers are disabled; no extrinsics are executed.
This release Wasm runs normal runtime-upgrade hooks, not try-runtime pre/post assertions.

limitations: No claim of a complete security audit or absence of all bugs; local regressions do not establish production exploitation or causation for every captured slash.

Genuinely oversized synchronous slashing cohorts remain above the block budget and are deliberately rejected. Supporting the full permitted nomination workload requires paginated financial processing; weights are never clamped to force admission.

Exposure scan is bounded at4096 overview entries and128 eras. Missing, stale, legacy or over-limit history uses a conservative non-admitting fallback. Current captured mainnet history has749 entries and at most113 aggregate nomination rows per era.
Handwritten weight allowances retain upstream costs and add conservative storage/CPU/queue bounds; no new hardware benchmark calibration was performed.
Existing queued slashes are not cancelled, historical stale queue keys are not automatically collected, and legitimately completed withdrawals are not retroactively relocked.
The earlier runtime-upgrade-4.8.9 preimage/proposal bundle predates these changes. This new candidate has not been submitted or deployed.
